textos.Dirigido por Spike Lee e lançado em 1989: Directed by Spike Lee and released in 1989, Do the Right Thing is a drama set in a predominantly Black neighborhood. The plot unfolds from an activist's demand that the owner of a local pizzeria include photos of Black idols on his wall of celebrities, leading to the organization of a boycott after he refuses.
textos.A obra se constrói em uma ambientação ma: The work is built on a setting marked by the expressive use of warm colors and the atmosphere of urban heat, developing its structure through a measured pace and a continuous rise in the intensity of the residents' coexistence.
textos.Os diferentes segmentos de avaliação abo: The different evaluation segments address the same central aspects of the work, diverging in their verdict on how well those choices work. Among the vast majority of ratings (~92%), many highlight the portrayal of the community and the diversity presented, while a significant share emphasizes the message about racism and social injustice. In this same set, several stress the performances and the construction of striking characters.
textos.Por outro lado, sob a perspectiva de que: By contrast, from the perspective of those making up a minimal fraction of ratings (~6%), a good portion report discomfort with the slow, dragging pace of the narrative. For this group, a considerable number point to discomfort with the excess of shouting on screen, while many criticize how the central message is conveyed. Finally, from the point of view of an even smaller fraction of ratings (~1%), several point to the slow pace and lack of story, a good portion classify the figures portrayed as caricatured, irritating characters, and a significant share judge the message as confusing or contradictory.
